<div id="about" align="center">
  <table width="100%">
    <tr>
      <td width="70%" valign="top" style="padding:0 30px;">
        <h2 style="font-size:32px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:10px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #00d4ff, #0099cc); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text;">About Me</h2>
        <p style="font-size:18px; line-height:1.7; color:#c9d1d9; max-width:600px; margin:0 auto;">
          I'm Boris, a full‑stack engineer who believes that great software is equal parts craft and engineering. I focus on <strong style="color:#00d4ff;">performance</strong>, <strong style="color:#00d4ff;">security</strong>, and <strong style="color:#00d4ff;">clean architecture</strong>—building products that feel effortless to use but are robust under the hood. Currently pouring that philosophy into <strong style="color:#00d4ff;">Conlink Messenger</strong>, a modern communication platform.
        </p>
      </td>
      <td width="30%" style="padding:20px;">
        <div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.15); border-radius:24px; padding:30px; backdrop-filter:blur(12px);">
          <p style="margin:8px 0; font-size:15px; color:#a8b2d1;">📍 Mission</p>
          <p style="margin:0 0 20px; font-size:16px; font-weight:500; color:#e5e7eb;">Create intuitive, high‑performance tools that respect users' privacy and time.</p>
          <p style="margin:8px 0; font-size:15px; color:#a8b2d1;">🧠 Values</p>
          <p style="margin:0 0 20px; font-size:16px; font-weight:500; color:#e5e7eb;">Code clarity, continuous learning, and radical simplicity.</p>
          <p style="margin:8px 0; font-size:15px; color:#a8b2d1;">⚙️ Philosophy</p>
          <p style="margin:0; font-size:16px; font-weight:500; color:#e5e7eb;">Measure twice, cut once. Ship fast, refactor often.</p>
        </div>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </table>
</div>

<div id="projects" align="center">
  <h2 style="font-size:32px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:30px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #00d4ff, #0099cc); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text;">Featured Project</h2>
  <div style="max-width:800px; margin:0 auto;">
    <div style="background:linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.05) 0%, rgba(0,212,255,0.01) 100%); border:1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.2); border-radius:28px; padding:40px; backdrop-filter:blur(20px); position:relative; overflow:hidden;">
      <div style="position:absolute; top:-50px; right:-50px; width:150px; height:150px; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,212,255,0.3) 0%, transparent 70%); filter:blur(30px);"></div>

        <div style="margin-left:20px;">
          <h3 style="font-size:28px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; margin:0;">Conlink Messenger</h3>
          <p style="color:#a8b2d1; font-size:16px; margin:5px 0 0;">Real‑time communication, beautifully engineered.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
